jobs.occupation: Senior Specialist, CMC Stability
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we are dedicated to transforming the lives of patients through innovative antibody-based medicines. To support our biologics pipeline and portfolio, we are looking for a CMC Senior Stability Specialist in the CMC Stability department to strengthen our CMC organization with a focus on life-cycle-management activities.

**The Role and Department

**As CMC Senior Stability Specialist, you will be part of the CMC Stability department organized in CMC Development and Manufacturing. The CMC Stability department supports the Genmab portfolio from early CMC development projects to commercial products. Additionally, you will be part of and collaborate with CMC project teams

You will join a department of eight skilled and dedicated employees. In the role, you will be responsible for stability, governance of products and collaborate closely with colleagues within the department, across CMC, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Supply, and with external partners at CDMO’s/CMO’s in a highly matrixed, international environment.

Besides having extended experience with biologics and stability, the ideal candidate is statistically well-founded and can help advance the department’s data-handling capabilities.

This position will report to the Head of Department, CMC Stability.

**Responsibilities

**

• Act as stability subject matter expert supporting Genmab’s biologics products.

• Ensure alignment and oversight of stability activities performed at external partners, CDMO’s/CMO’s, and internal laboratories.

• Ensure scientifically sound and regulatory-compliant stability approaches aligned with ICH guidelines and regulations.

• Perform and oversee statistical evaluation of stability data, including data handling, trend analysis and shelf-life determination.

• Author and review CMC sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, BLA/MAA, variations).

• Support health authority interactions, e.g. be part of the request for information processes for topics related to stability.

• Be part of establishing a mature life-cycle-management set-up for commercial products.

**Requirements

**

• PhD or MSc in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, biochemistry, statistics, or related discipline.

• Significant experience (typically 7+ years) within CMC stability for biologics and strong knowledge of ICH guidelines, including Q1A–Q1E, Q5C, and Q6B.

• Extensive knowledge and understanding of stability for marketed biologics/clinical biological products according to current requirements and best industrial practices.

• Demonstrated knowledge and experience in statistical methods applied to stability data (e.g. regression analysis, pooling, trend analysis).

• Experience working and interacting with CDMO’s/CMO’s.

• Experience with supporting global regulatory submissions.

• Ability to translate complex scientific and statistical data into clear regulatory and business recommendations.

**Moreover, You Meet The Following Personal Requirements

**

• You seek and have demonstrated ability to collaborate with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders to support product development programs.

• You have a structured and analytical approach when solving problems.

• Flair for IT and user software to monitor stability.

• You can manage multiple tasks, prioritize work, and define steps needed to achieve project and department goals.

• You can work successfully and with integrity in a fast-paced environment with tight timelines.

**What You Can Expect At Genmab

**

• A high-impact role in a science-driven organization focused on patients.

• A collaborative and inclusive culture with strong cross-functional teamwork.

• Opportunities to shape strategy and contribute to key project decisions.

• Professional growth in a global biologics company with a strong pipeline.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

jobs.occupation: Engineering Team Lead – Cloud Platform
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Every day, thousands of manufacturers rely on Secomea's Secure Remote Access platform to securely connect engineers with the industrial equipment that keeps factories, utilities, and critical infrastructure running.

Secomea is entering its next phase of accelerated growth. Building on strong commercial momentum, the company is now strengthening its engineering teams as a strategic foundation for further growth.

We're hiring an Engineering Team Lead for one of our Cloud teams, reporting directly to the VP of Engineering. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with people leadership.

This is a role with significant influence in a growing international company where initiative, technical excellence, accountability, and impact matter.

What You'll Do

As Engineering Team Lead, you'll lead one of the engineering teams building the customer-facing heart of our cloud layer that brings together identity, governance, secure access, APIs, and user experience into a seamless experience trusted by industrial organizations worldwide. It enables enterprise IT to centrally govern secure access while allowing technicians to quickly find, access, and work with the industrial resources they're responsible for.

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role where leadership is an addition to engineering—not a move away from it. You'll spend much of your time designing, coding, reviewing code, solving complex technical problems, contributing to architectural decisions, and supporting production operations while serving as the direct people leader for your team.

You will work closely with UX, Product Management, and engineering teams across the platform to deliver intuitive user experience while maintaining the enterprise-grade governance, security, and reliability that industrial customers expect.

You'll solve challenging engineering problems spanning distributed cloud systems, APIs, identity, governance, scalability, observability, security, and user experience.

As a people leader, you will coach and support team members through regular feedback, development discussions, hiring activities, and performance management. You will drive engineering excellence through sound architecture, high code quality, and continuous improvement.

Success in this role requires both technical depth and the ability to create clarity, build trust, and help a team perform at a high level.

You will be part of Secomea's engineering leadership community, working closely with other Team Leads and Engineering Managers to evolve our technology organization, engineering practices, and technical direction.

What We’re Looking For

You may already be leading a team, or you may be a senior engineer who naturally takes ownership, mentors colleagues, and drives technical initiatives. In either case, you are motivated by helping people succeed and understand that strong teams are built through trust, communication, and shared accountability.

You have a strong software engineering background and significant experience building distributed software systems using modern technologies such as .NET and Azure. More importantly, you're curious, adaptable, and comfortable learning new technologies as products and platforms evolve.

Most importantly, we are looking for a strong team player who thrives in a rapidly growing environment and is energized by combining deep technical work with leading and inspiring people.

Experience We Value

You don't need to tick every box below, but you should bring a solid foundation in .NET and modern cloud technologies.

Core Skills

• Strong experience with C# and .NET

• Ability and curiosity to quickly master new technologies

• Experience with modern databases, preferably document databases

• Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools in production settings

• Unit and integration testing — xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest; comfortable with TDD or BDD

• Ability to work closely with UX and Product Management to translate customer needs into intuitive product experiences

Cloud Skills

• Experience designing scalable, high-performance distributed systems, including performance analysis and optimization.

• Experience designing, deploying, and operating distributed applications in public cloud environments. Experience with Azure is an advantage. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is a strong advantage.

• Experience designing secure, scalable, and intuitive APIs.

Security and OT Knowledge

• Core security concepts — encryption, authentication, and authorization for web applications and APIs.

• Operational Technology (preferred) — familiarity with OT protocols such as Modbus, OPC UA, or MQTT, and the unique security challenges of ICS and SCADA environments.

Leadership Qualifications

• Proven experience as a senior technical contributor with the ability and desire to remain hands-on while leading others.

• You may already be leading a team, mentoring junior engineers, acting as a Staff Engineer, or simply be the person others naturally turn to for technical guidance. We care more about your ability to help others succeed than about previous management titles.

Just as important, you:

• Take ownership and drive tasks to completion

• Proactively identify gaps, risks, and improvements.

• Translate high-level goals into concrete technical outcomes

• Care about building robust systems that are stable and perform reliably in the real world.

You do not need to meet every requirement to be successful in the role. We value curiosity, ownership, and the ability to learn as highly as specific technical experience.

About Secomea

Secomea is a global leader in Operational Technology (OT) and secure remote access solutions for industrial environments. We help manufacturers, machine builders, and system integrators securely connect, monitor, and manage industrial equipment around the world.

Founded in Denmark in 2008, Secomea has spent more than fifteen years helping organizations enable protected access to their critical industrial infrastructure while supporting efficient and secure operations. Today, we serve customers globally through our offices in Denmark, the United States, Japan, and China, through a network of partners across more than 70 countries.

As cybersecurity and compliance become increasingly critical to industrial operations, our mission remains simple: Protecting the factory floor.

Why Join Secomea?

This role combines technical depth, product thinking, architectural influence, and people leadership in equal measure.

You'll help shape the customer-facing heart of Secomea's cloud layer, solving engineering challenges where distributed systems, identity, security, APIs, and user experience come together. Success isn't measured only by the quality of the software you build, but by how naturally enterprise governance and technician productivity work together.

As a Team Lead, you'll have genuine influence. You'll help shape the technical direction of the cloud layer, grow an experienced engineering team, and work closely with Product Management, UX, and fellow engineering leaders to define how the cloud layer evolves. You'll remain close to technology while helping others succeed.

Perhaps most importantly, your work has a tangible impact. Every improvement your team delivers helps manufacturers and critical infrastructure operators securely connect the people who keep factories, utilities, and essential infrastructure running. It's engineering where technical excellence directly improves how people work in the real world.

You'll join an engineering organization that's large enough to build globally trusted products, yet small enough that your technical decisions, leadership, and ideas genuinely shape the future of both the product and the company.

How To Apply

Ready to take the next step?

Submit your CV and let’s start the conversation. We are more interested in meeting the right person than finding someone who checks every box. If you are excited about leading talented engineers while remaining deeply involved in building secure, high-performance systems, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, not just juice, sandwiches, coffee, and much more. When joining us, you step into a high-energy community where the music is loud, the bar is your stage, and your personality matters as much as your skills.

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

From your first day, you’ll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing, move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion, and be part of a company where most leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!).

If you love fast-paced service, music, people, and the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that can take you across cities, countries, and roles.

**Job Summary

**The Security Architect is responsible for defining and driving the Group cyber security architecture and roadmap across the entire technology portfolio, ensuring robust protection, regulatory compliance, and resilience at a global scale. The role establishes security standards, frameworks, and controls across all platforms, applications, and infrastructure, working closely with IT Operations, Product, and Engineering Teams to embed security by design throughout the organization.

As part of the global technology leadership team, this position plays a strategic role in strengthening the company’s cyber posture, safeguarding business operations, and enabling secure growth by ensuring that security capabilities evolve alongside the company’s digital and operational ambitions.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and evolve the company’s global security architecture and strategy across applications, cloud, identity, endpoints, and enterprise systems.

• Lead and develop the security function, managing a team responsible for Security Operations and Identity & Access Management.

• Serve as the senior security authority for major technology initiatives, architectural decisions, and enterprise platform changes.

• Define and maintain security principles, standards, and reference architectures applied consistently across engineering teams and regions.

• Ensure security architecture aligns with business priorities, technology strategy, and regulatory requirements.

• Drive secure-by-design practices across internally developed applications, APIs, and integrations.

• Oversee the organization’s cloud security posture, including architecture, governance, and controls across AWS environments.

• Establish and strengthen identity and access management practices, including authentication, privileged access, and lifecycle governance.

• Ensure effective security operations, monitoring, and endpoint protection in partnership with internal teams and external security providers.

• Oversee security testing and assurance activities, including penetration testing, vulnerability management, and remediation oversight.

• Drive the organization’s security awareness and human risk program to strengthen overall security culture.

• Act as a trusted advisor to engineering and business leadership, clearly communicating security risks, priorities, and improvement initiatives.

**Key Qualifications

**

• 8–10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, or related infrastructure/security roles, including experience in security architecture or senior security engineering roles.

• Strong understanding of security architecture across cloud, applications, identity, endpoints, and enterprise platforms.

• Hands-on experience securing cloud environments, preferably AWS, including IAM, monitoring, and security controls.

• Solid background in application security and secure software development practices, including threat modeling, architecture review, and API security.

• Practical experience with identity and access management concepts such as authentication, privileged access, and lifecycle governance.

• Familiarity with Microsoft security environments, including Entra ID; experience with enterprise SaaS platforms such as Dynamics is a plus.

• Experience working closely with engineering, infrastructure, and platform teams to embed security into technology delivery.

• Experience overseeing security operations or working with MSSPs, including areas such as endpoint protection, detection and response, or monitoring.

• Proven ability to lead security initiatives, influence stakeholders, and guide security improvements across multiple teams.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate security risks into clear priorities and practical actions for both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred

**

• Experience in distributed or multi-site environments (e.g., retail, hospitality, or similar).

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or equivalent are advantageous but not required.

**About Joe & The Juice

**JOE & THE JUICE is a healthy fast-casual concept founded in Copenhagen in 2002. Since then, we've grown to more than 500 locations across 20+ countries, employing more than 4,500 people worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028. From day one, our ambition has been to prove there's no trade-off between taste and health.

We serve high-quality, freshly prepared juices, shakes, coffee, and sandwiches in relaxed, contemporary cafés that combine convenience with distinct urban atmospheres. JOE & THE JUICE goes beyond products towards the full experience around the bar, creating one consistent universe for guests and Juicers across every location.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future.

Leadership & Educational Programs: Access continuous learning and growth opportunities through our comprehensive internal programs, workshops, training sessions, and mentorship designed to build your professional and leadership skills.

Travel & Development Opportunities: Experience diverse cultures and locations while developing your career. Take advantage of exchange programs, international assignments, and advancement opportunities that let you grow within the company and explore new horizons.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

jobs.occupation: Head of Financial Crime Prevention
jobs.description:
The Head of Financial Crime Prevention sits within Framm , the dedicated service organisation which is a part of Inpay Holding that delivers KYC and AML operations to Inpay A/S, the regulated, licensed entity where Compliance and the MLRO are seated. The role is responsible for leading, stabilising and elevating KYC and AML delivery - owning the day-to-day people leadership of a 10-person team, and ensuring the function operates with clear priorities, strong execution discipline and appropriate governance against Inpay A/S's regulatory obligations and commercial needs.

As a member of extended leadership team, the Head of Financial Crime Prevention represents the function in cross-organisational forums with Inpay A/S and contributes to broader business planning, without holding executive authority. The role reports directly to the Managing Director.

The role is critical to strengthening operational performance, reducing backlog, improving transparency, and driving KYC & AML service delivery towards a sustainable, scalable operating model as the company moves into a phase of operational excellence.

Key responsibilities

1. Lead and develop the Financial Crime Prevention team

• Take full day-to-day people leadership responsibility for a team of 10 across KYC and AML operations within the company

• Create structure, clarity and direction in a business-critical, currently under-led area

• Build trust, accountability and a stronger performance culture within the team

• Set clear roles, responsibilities and ways of working across KYC and AML

• Coach, develop and grow team members; own recruitment, onboarding and performance management for the team

• As a member of extended leadership team, represent KYC & AML priorities and constraints in leadership discussions and in engagement with Inpay A/S

2. Drive operational execution and excellence

• Own the transition of the KYC & AML function towards operational excellence: consistent SLAs, KPIs and a clear operating cadence for service delivery to Inpay A/S

• Establish clear priorities and ensure disciplined follow-through across the team

• Remove existing backlog and improve turnaround times against agreed service levels

• Monitor team capacity, workload balancing and case progression

• Introduce simple but effective rhythms for tracking delivery, surfacing bottlenecks and managing risk, with visibility for Inpay A/S stakeholders

3. Strengthen KYC & AML processes and governance

• Review and improve KYC and AML workflows, handovers and escalation paths, including CDD/ODD/EDD/EDR and ongoing monitoring

• Ensure processes are fit for purpose, scalable and aligned with Inpay A/S's regulatory requirements

• Improve documentation, transparency and management reporting to Inpay A/S

• Own and maintain the service governance model between Framm and Inpay A/S — including the service agreement/SLAs, escalation paths, and regular service review with Compliance and the MLRO

• Ensure clear separation of accountability: Framm delivers the operational service; Inpay A/S (Compliance/MLRO) retains regulatory ownership and oversight

Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Agroecology programme. The position is available from 01 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Deciphering host-pathogen interplay by utilizing biostructure prediction and New Genomic Techniques (NGTs) to engineer durable disease resistance in plants

Research area and project description
The Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University is offering a PhD position focused on genetic modification of plants for higher resistance to pathogens. The position is available from 01-02-2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

The PhD is part of the project that aims to develop novel and durable disease resistance in cereals by targeting key protein–protein interactions between plants and pathogens. Using hexaploid wheat (Triticum aestivum) and diploid barley (Hordeum vulgare) as model systems, the project will focus on
powdery mildew disease caused by Blumeria graminis f. sp. tritici (Bgt) and B. hordei (Bh).

The PhD student will establish and optimize an AI-based structural biology modelling and prime editing toolbox and apply it to introduce genome modification in vitro culture. These edits are designed to disrupt critical plant-pathogen protein interactions, thereby enhancing disease resistance without relying on classical resistance genes. Computational prediction tools, including AlphaFold-based protein-protein interaction modeling, will be used to guide target selection and interpret the molecular effects of the edits. Wheat transformation will be carried out in three varieties with contrasting resistance profiles, and barley transformation will be done in Golden Promise. Disease resistance will be assessed through controlled inoculation experiments. Edited and wild-type plants will be inoculated with Blumeria graminis isolates and evaluated at the whole-plant level.

Overall, the project aims to establish a new resistance concept based on blocking essential plant-pathogen interactions rather than relying on single resistance genes. This strategy has the potential to deliver more robust and durable disease resistance and to open new avenues for precision breeding in cereal crops.

The position is funded by a project supported by the DFF, in collaboration with Copenhagen University and will last 3 years.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants to the PhD position must hold a relevant MSc degree within molecular biology, plant or agricultural sciences, biology, biotechnology or similar.

The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As a Data Engineer with BI expertise, you will help design, build, operate, and improve our analytics platform and the data products built on it. You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver reliable data pipelines, intuitive BI solutions, and user-friendly data services. 

Your work will directly influence how Nordic RCC uses data to improve processes, services, and operational decision-making. Your key responsibilities will include: 

• 
Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, data models, integrations, and curated datasets. 

• 
Develop BI dashboards, reports, and data products that turn complex data into clear insights. 

• 
Operate and improve analytics platform services, including data platforms, BI solutions, JupyterHub, user-facing analytics environments, and supporting applications. 

• 
Ensure data quality, reliability, monitoring, and operational visibility across pipelines, BI products, and platform services. 

• 
Monitor and optimize platform performance, resource use, computer storage, and analytical workloads. 

• 
Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver production-ready analytics solutions. 

• 
Support the development of platform architecture, metadata, governance practices, and service-oriented delivery models such as Data-as-a-Service and Platform-as-a-Service. 

• 
Document data flows, platform components, operational procedures, and technical solutions to support maintainability and knowledge sharing. 

We are looking for someone with several of the following qualifications: 

• 
Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, Platform Engineer, Application Developer, or similar. 

• 
Strong experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, modern data architectures, SQL, and data warehousing concepts. 

• 
Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar. 

• 
Experience operating and optimizing analytics platforms in production environments. 

• 
Experience with cloud-native technologies and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or similar. 

• 
Familiarity with orchestration, monitoring, DevOps, CI/CD, Python, containerization, Kubernetes, storage solutions, or data platform infrastructure 

• 
Experience operationalizing analytics models, enabling data consumption, or supporting service-oriented delivery models is an advantage. 

• 
Knowledge of power systems and the energy sector is a plus, but not a requirement. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. Your experience and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for. 

Working Environment 

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

We offer flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, including the option to work from home part of the time. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, physical presence in the office is expected on most days. 

You’ll report to Data & Analytics team-lead and collaborate regularly with colleagues from the Nordic RCC and occasionally also from the Nordic TSOs. Travel is limited and will not exceed 15 days per year. 

Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.occupation: Demand & Supply Manager Nordics
jobs.description:
**Turn complexity into one plan the business can act on.

****What if planning could shape the future, not just react to it?

**Across the Nordics, demand is shaped by tenders, contracts, launches and changing customer needs. The opportunity is to bring those signals together early, translate them into clear choices and create a healthier balance between product availability and inventory. That is where you come in.

As our Demand & Supply Manager Nordics, you will create one reliable view of demand and supply across Denmark, Sweden, and Finland. You will own the Nordic Sales and Operations Planning cycle, lead a distributed planning team and help move the organization from reactive expediting towards confident, forward-looking decisions.

**Your impact

****Role

**This is not a role where you simply maintain a forecast. You will set the direction for how the Nordics plan, decide and improve. You will:

• Own one Nordic demand and supply plan, bringing tender and contract intelligence into the forecast early enough to influence decisions.

• Lead the full S&OP cycle, from portfolio and demand reviews through supply and management review, with clear monthly decisions and ownership.

• Take accountability for inventory health, availability and the working-capital effect of the plan, while preventing excess and risk stock from rebuilding.

• Lead and develop four planners and one analyst across Denmark, Sweden and Finland, creating one way of working that is resilient across countries and absences.

• Connect sales, category, tender, sourcing, finance, warehouse and transport around the same facts, priorities and actions.

**What Will Make You Successful

**You combine strong planning craft with practical leadership. You are comfortable moving between item-level detail and senior stakeholder decisions, and you know how to challenge constructively when the numbers tell a different story.

**You Are Likely To Bring

**

• 8-12 years in supply chain, including at least five years in demand and supply planning or S&OP.

• Experience owning a full S&OP or IBP cycle and leading a planning team, ideally across more than one country.

• Strong knowledge of inventory, working capital, forecast quality and excess or obsolete stock.

• Hands-on experience with an advanced planning system such as Slim4, o9, Kinaxis, SAP IBP or a comparable platform, plus strong Excel or BI skills.

• Professional English and, preferably, Danish or Swedish.

• A relevant Bachelor or Master degree. APICS, IBF or an equivalent certification is an advantage.

**The environment you will step into

**The scope is genuinely Nordic and the mandate is broad. You will have the space to shape the process while keeping the daily business moving.

You will work closely on standards, tools and the group excess and risk stock process. Your influence will reach well beyond your direct team, so trust, clarity and follow-through will matter as much as technical expertise.

**Ready to build what comes next?

**If you want to lead a cross-border team, create one Nordic planning approach and turn better demand and supply decisions into stronger service and healthier inventory, we would like to hear from you.

Location: Copenhagen Denmark or Kungsbacka Sweden. Travel: Regular travel within the Nordics and Europe is part of the role.

**Apply and help shape one Nordic view of demand and supply

**Submit your application through CareersatMediq.com or contact Artjoms.Bikovskis@Mediq.com, Talent Acquisition Partner Nordics and Baltics. We review every application with care and look forward to learning what you could bring to this next chapter of Nordic planning.

**About Mediq

**Mediq is a leading European healthcare company with a 125-year legacy, operating in 14 countries with over 3,000 employees. Guided by our vision to enable sustainable healthcare, we focus on improving care outcomes and affordability through innovative products, services, and solutions. Partnering with healthcare professionals across hospitals, clinics, and home care, we ensure patients receive the care they need to live independently, securely and feel more human.

At Mediq we offer jobs that change lives, join us.

The Siteimprove Search Insights team builds the tools our customers use to understand and improve how their content performs in search, both in classic search engines and in the AI assistants that increasingly answer questions on their behalf. We work at enterprise scale, with large volumes of crawled and third party search data, visibility and ranking analysis, and features that turn that data into recommendations marketers can act on.

We are also changing how we build. AI is part of every step, from requirements, to breaking work down, to implementing and reviewing it with coding agents. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who wants to build this way, and who helps us define the standard while we do it.

Tech stack you will be working with

• C# and .NET, TypeScript, React

• AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes

• Event driven services and large scale data pipelines

• GitHub Actions for CI and CD

• Claude Code and other coding agents, MCP servers, Jira and Confluence as the working surface for the AI PDLC

What we will be doing

• Contribute to the technical direction of the team. Write the system designs for the work you own, take part in design reviews, and argue for the option you believe is right.

• Design and build systems yourself: services, APIs and data pipelines that stay stable, fast and affordable as data volumes grow.

• Lead our use of AI across the product development lifecycle. Take a product requirements document to a technical vision and system designs, break it into epics and user stories that an agent can act on, and set the standard at each step.

• Improve the scaffolding that makes agent driven delivery work: context and instruction files, prompts and skills, and the review and testing practice that keeps quality high when code arrives faster than before.

• Keep search data trustworthy, with tests, monitoring and errors a colleague can understand.

• Define how we measure quality, detect drift, and explain results to customers who make decisions based on them.

• Mentor engineers at all levels through design reviews, pairing and written technical proposals, including how to work well with agents.

• Treat cost, performance and operability as design inputs from the start.

• Take part in the daily work of the team: refinement, estimation, prototyping, debugging and production support.

• Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science.

• 10 or more years of professional software development experience.

• 5 or more years building and running services and APIs on a public cloud, preferably AWS.

• A track record of architecture decisions that span several teams, including the trade offs you rejected and why.

• You have owned features or services end to end, including what happened after they were released.

• Hands on experience using coding agents in real production work, with a clear view of where they help and where they do not.

• Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms and data structures, and a commitment to technical excellence.

• Excellent written and verbal English. You write proposals and designs that other people, and agents, can act on without a meeting.

• Willingness to work across the stack when the problem calls for it.

What we will love about you

• Experience turning product requirements into technical designs and a delivery plan that a team can execute.

• Experience with search, SEO, crawling, indexing, ranking or web scale data.

• Experience with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

• Experience working in a team distributed across Europe and North America.
